changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).
Platform heights from Bane NOR's station page, track table (facts); 8 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/NO-MOS).
